findings.claim: The build-required entries are not traceable to the analyzed gaps because all three use null capability_gap_id despite named gaps being available.
findings.evidence: library-candidates.json lists "gaps_addressed": ["current-bundled-startup", "execution-bound-approvals", "job-delegation-continuity", "eligible-regression-review", "private-launch-roots", "release-scope"], but each build_required item has "capability_gap_id": null, including "Private packaged startup root contract or established isolated OS-user environment", which directly corresponds to "private-launch-roots".
findings.suggested_fix: Populate capability_gap_id for each build_required item with the relevant gap IDs, e.g. private-launch-roots/current-bundled-startup for the startup-root contract, release-scope/eligible-regression-review for cumulative review, and current-bundled-startup/job-delegation-continuity/eligible-regression-review for the coordinator.
